description: Use this when managing post auto-signatures. Set the account default, channel-specific override or single-post override. For default use custom/none; for channel/post inherit follows their defaults, none disables it, custom selects signatureId. Previously queued publication snapshots remain unchanged. Never publishes.

channelId.description: Owner-bound channel id from list_channels; never invent a recipient.

draftId.description: Owner-bound draftId from search_post_drafts/create_post_draft; same as postId.

selection.description: Signature selection: custom requires signatureId; none disables the optional signature; inherit follows defaults for channel/post only.

mode.description: inherit follows defaults (channel/post only); none disables the optional signature; custom requires signatureId.

target.description: Binding to change: default for the account, channel requires channelId, post requires draftId.

name: assign_signature

mode.description: inherit follows defaults (channel/post only); none disables the optional signature; custom requires signatureId.

title: Assign an auto-signature
